accuracy.evidence: Checked for m100: 300=3h0t0o; 700 empty tens; 400>40; 5 hundreds=500; aligns CCSS 2.NBT.1.b / NC Y2 multiples of 100.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked for m100: traps for 400 as 4 tens; 500 written 50; zeros as decoration; 700 placed like 70 on the line.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked for m100: hundred-flats and empty tens/ones focus; not flagtenten (ten tens→100) or flaghund (hop-count within 1000).

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked for m100: learner builds 300 flats, fills chart to 700, marks line, compares 400 vs 40, chooses 500.

predictions.evidence: Checked for m100: wrong options on 300 meaning, tens in 700, 400 vs 40, two-zero rule, 5 hundreds writing.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked for m100: why() splits tens/ones/sevens, forty/eq, fifty/five, onez/any, long/gone with place-value corrections.

readability.evidence: Checked for m100: ages 7–8 kid lines use hundred, tens, ones, zeros; adult names place value within family bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked for m100: every kid/adult sentence defines multiples of 100, names a slip, or describes a lab action.
